name: smwmusic-mega-man-10-silent-rain-dr-wily-stage
title: Mega Man 10 - Silent Rain (Dr. Wily Stage 1)
description:
This is my 1:1 port of "Mega Man 10 - Silent Rain (Dr. Wily Stage 1 - Entrance)"!
I personally fell in love with the dark setting this song creates thats why I decided to give this port a shot!

I recommend the "Lower Volume When Pausing" patch by KevinM while using this port. It prevents the audio from breaking when pausing the game!

Thanks to Slash Man for the MIDI! <3
